title: Two Months Old
desc: Two months of being your parents. You're tracking faces now, sleeping in longer stretches, and somehow getting even more beautiful.
story: 4.9 kg and 56cm tall. You've found your voice and you use it constantly — happy little coos and gurgles that fill every room. You love being carried facing outward so you can see everything. You're already so curious about the world. It suits you perfectly.
